title: Floating letter toss partner lockup
summary: Two partner names, each as oversized single letters tossed up from below and drifting in slow rotation, joined by a spinning cross on a colour flip. Weightless letter motion makes a plain name pairing playful.
use_when: Announcing a partnership or collab: name, cross, name
A short silent title card where the type itself is the entertainment
Social loops and story openers under 3 s
Brands with a short name of 4 to 7 letters

look.type_style: geometric grotesk caps, medium weight, single letters about 45 % of frame height, each rotated -30 to +30 deg; tiny tracked caps labels on a hairline at mid height

sfx.event: cross glyph enters on the colour flip

structure.shot: first partner name as 6 huge light letters scattered and rotated over flat grey; hairline with 3 small labels at mid height
structure.motion: letters tossed up from below the frame edge, rise to apex at ~0.50 s, fall back out of frame by 1.00 s; slow independent rotation, easings.outQuint up, easings.inExpo down (±0.25 s, apex and spin rate not measurable)

structure.shot: background flips to saturated blue; one small rotated cross glyph (the joiner) alone near centre
structure.motion: cross enters from the bottom edge at 1.07 s, rises to apex above the hairline at ~1.50 s, falls to lower right by 1.77 s while spinning ~45 deg, easings.outQuint up / easings.inExpo down (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: second partner name plus a registered-style circle mark as huge black letters on light grey; a 3D hand sticker joins at 2.27 s
structure.camera: static frame; letters drift up then settle (motion estimate 443 px/s up at 1920 w in this second)
structure.motion: letters tossed up from below at 1.90 s, near apex by 2.27 s, begin to sink by 2.50 s with slow rotation; hand sticker pops up from the bottom edge at ~2.27 s, springs.pop (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s)

params.brand: brand.json: display font for the letters, bg and fg per scene, accent for the joiner scene
params.content.nameA: first partner name, 4-7 letters, one letter per tossed glyph
params.content.nameB: second partner name, 4-7 letters, optional trailing circle mark
params.content.joiner: glyph shown alone in the middle scene (default a cross)
params.content.sticker: optional cutout image that pops in on the last scene
params.content.labels: 3 tiny labels on the mid hairline (left, centre, right)
params.seed: seed for letter positions and rotations
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets only (±0.25 s). Scenes 32 / 25 / 23 fr at 30 fps. Letters never settle: each scene is one toss up and fall, which is the whole effect. Background flip grey to blue at 1.07 s is read as a cut (soft window 0.63-1.07 s is the letters leaving). The motion reads as 2D rigid-body gravity; vocabulary `physics` sits under 3d, so it is not used here, see Proposed terms (flat-gravity-toss). Cross and circle mark stay in fg colour. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
